comment: for_each as an LLM tool, http_request target. The agent exposes `batch_update_users` (node_type: for_each) whose embedded target is an http_request POST to a real echo endpoint (postman-echo.com/post). The LLM supplies the `items` array (one row per user) from a realistic prompt; for_each fans the request out deterministically, one HTTP call per row, and returns a result table (not the LLM re-looping per user).

test_payload.prompt: Update the plan to pro for users 101, 102, 103.

config.system_message: You update user accounts via the `batch_update_users` tool. Always use the tool (never answer from memory). Build the `items` array from the user's request — one row per user id, each with the target plan. After the tool returns, summarize how many updates succeeded and how many failed.

batch_update_users.name: batch_update_users
batch_update_users.description: Apply a plan update to a batch of users, one HTTP call per user, deterministically. Provide `items` as an array of rows, each with `user_id` (number) and `plan` (string).

items.description: One row per user to update.

plan.description: The plan to set for the user, e.g. 'pro'.
